name: rosetta-url-encoding
code:
use default
use System.Text.Encoding

percent_encoded(octet: ubyte) -> string =>
    (let character = cast char(octet)

     if char.is_ascii_letter_or_digit(character) then
         "{character}"
     else
         "%{octet:X2}"
     fi)

url_encode(text: string) -> string =>
    Encoding.utf8.get_bytes(text)
        |> map(percent_encoded)
        |> join("")

["http://foo bar/",
 "ghul.dev/search?q=ghūl language",
 "%25"]
    |> each(text => write_line("{text} -> {url_encode(text)}"))
